title: Jehoahaz, Jehoiakim and Jeconiah: The Kings of Judah Before the Exile
description: A chronological account of three kings of Judah in the period before the exile: Jehoahaz, who reigned for three months before being deposed by the king of Egypt and taken to Egypt; Jehoiakim, who was bound with bronze chains by Nebuchadnezzar and had vessels from the temple carried off to Babylon; and Jeconiah, who after three months and ten days was taken to Babylon along with the precious vessels from the Lord's house.
